project.name.label: Project name
project.name.description: The name of the formalized result or project.

project.authors.label: Project authors
project.authors.description: People who authored the formalization. Enter one person per line and do not infer missing authorship.

project.license.label: Project license
project.license.description: The SPDX identifier for the repository license; it must agree with the repository license file.

project.responsible_maintainers.label: Responsible maintainers
project.responsible_maintainers.description: People responsible for the submitted formalization. Enter one person per line.

repository.role.label: Repository role
repository.role.description: Whether this repository contains the substantive development or is a thin wrapper around another repository.

classification.arxiv.label: arXiv classifications
classification.arxiv.description: One or two arXiv category codes that describe the mathematical content.

classification.msc2020.label: MSC 2020 classifications
classification.msc2020.description: Between one and eight MSC 2020 classification codes.

sources.label: Mathematical sources
sources.description: A nonempty list describing the mathematical result's sources and each source's relationship to this formalization.

automation.methods.label: Automation methods
automation.methods.description: A nonempty list of the proof automation or formalization methods used.

review.status.label: Review status
review.status.description: The current review status claimed by the submitter; this is metadata, not a Palomar endorsement.
